_README: AI short-drama generation plan. Copy to <project>/production.json and fill in.
One segment = one API call = one multi-shot generation (3-6 shots inside).
The per-shot seconds MUST sum to settings.duration, or the API rejects the call.
title: My Short Drama

settings._canvas: output resolution WxH; also drives subtitle scaling
settings._titleCardSeconds: black end card length; the last segment is trimmed by this much

_bgmPlan: Optional. Tiles the bgm/<file> cues to fill the timeline; durations should sum to
segments.length * settings.duration. Omit to loop warm.mp3 across the whole film.
style_lock: cinematic photorealistic live-action, vertical 9:16, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, NOT anime, NOT CGI

segments.title: Hook
segments.prompt: IMPORTANT CHARACTER NOTE: <defining trait> must be clearly visible in every shot <pronoun> appears in. <full character sheet>. <language constraint, if any> shot 1, 4, <low angle on an object, camera reveals the character + action>. <style string>; shot 2, 3, <reverse shot, second character reacts>. <style string>; shot 3, 3, <closing beat of the segment>. <style string>

segments.title: Cause / flashback
segments.prompt: IMPORTANT CHARACTER NOTE: <same character sheet, verbatim>. shot 1, 4, <establishing cold-night image>. <style string>; shot 2, 3, <the pivotal action>. <style string>; shot 3, 3, <emotional close-up, with the anti-anime guard>. <style string>

segments.title: Turn / reveal
segments.prompt: IMPORTANT CHARACTER NOTE: <same character sheet, verbatim>. shot 1, 3, <disruption: a sound, a flash, a knock>. <style string>; shot 2, 3, <tension beat>. <style string>; shot 3, 4, <the reveal>. <style string>

segments.title: Montage
segments.prompt: IMPORTANT CHARACTER NOTE: <same character sheet, verbatim>. shot 1, 3, <behaviour gag 1>. <style string>; shot 2, 2, <behaviour gag 2>. <style string>; shot 3, 3, <behaviour gag 3>. <style string>; shot 4, 2, <behaviour gag 4>. <style string>

segments.title: Intimacy
segments.prompt: IMPORTANT CHARACTER NOTE: <same character sheet, verbatim>. shot 1, 4, <care-taking beat>. <style string>; shot 2, 3, <small gesture>. <style string>; shot 3, 3, <the quiet payoff>. <style string>

segments.title: Resolution + button
segments.prompt: IMPORTANT CHARACTER NOTE: <same character sheet, verbatim>. <characters speak this language only>. shot 1, 3, <the last spoken line, one short line: ...>. <style string>; shot 2, 3, <close-up, anti-anime guard, No dialogue in this shot.>. <style string>; shot 3, 2, <rest beat>. <style string>; shot 4, 2, <button: straight to camera, then cut to black>. <style string>

_editing.order: S1 -> S2 -> S3 -> S4 -> S5 -> S6. No reordering needed if start values are cumulative.
_editing.lastSegmentTrim: assemble.js automatically trims the LAST segment by settings.titleCardSeconds and appends that much black, so the total stays exact.
_editing.audioMode: Setting a segment's audio to 'native' makes final-mix.js use that clip's own audio track instead of clips/<id>_amb.mp3.
_editing.audioGain: Optional per-segment level correction, e.g. 1.7 to lift a quiet speech segment by ~4.6 dB.
_editing.grades: Optional per-segment ffmpeg filter chain, applied during normalisation.
_editing.subtitles: Author subs.srt against the cumulative plan timeline, then fine-tune after reviewing the contact sheet.
